scenarios.title: Access Gemini Home Page Interface
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure authenticated users can access the main Gemini interface with all required UI components
preconditions: User is logged into Gemini
steps: User navigates to the Gemini Home page
User verifies the prompt textbox is displayed
User verifies the Model selector is displayed
User verifies the Microphone button is displayed
User verifies the Sidebar is displayed
scenarios.expected_result: All required UI components are visible and accessible on the Home page

traceability.section: TC-001 - Verify Home Page Loads Successfully

scenarios.title: Enter Text into Prompt Interface
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to input text prompts for AI interaction
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Prompt textbox is visible and accessible
steps: User clicks on the prompt textbox
User types text into the prompt textbox
User observes the entered text
scenarios.expected_result: The text entered by the user is displayed in the prompt textbox

scenarios.title: Submit Prompt Using Submit Button
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to submit prompts via button click and initiate AI conversation
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
User has entered text into the prompt textbox
steps: User clicks the Submit button
User observes the prompt appears in the conversation area
User observes the AI response generation begins
scenarios.expected_result: The submitted prompt appears in the conversation and AI response generation starts

traceability.section: TC-003 - Submit Prompt using Submit Button

scenarios.title: Submit Prompt Using Enter Key
scenarios.business_objective: Provide keyboard shortcut for efficient prompt submission
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
User has entered text into the prompt textbox
Prompt textbox has focus
steps: User presses the Enter key
User observes the prompt is submitted
scenarios.expected_result: The prompt is submitted and AI response generation begins

traceability.section: TC-004 - Submit Prompt using Enter Key

scenarios.title: Create Multi-line Prompt
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to create formatted multi-line prompts without accidental submission
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Prompt textbox has focus
steps: User enters text into the prompt textbox
User presses Shift + Enter
User observes a new line is inserted
User enters additional text on the new line
scenarios.expected_result: The prompt textbox contains multiple lines of text without submitting the prompt

traceability.section: TC-005 - Verify Shift + Enter Inserts New Line

scenarios.title: Browse Available AI Models
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to view and select from available AI models
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Model selector is visible
steps: User clicks on the Model dropdown
User observes the list of available models is displayed
scenarios.expected_result: A dropdown list showing available AI models is displayed

scenarios.title: Switch AI Model
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to select different AI models for their conversations
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Model dropdown is open showing available models
steps: User selects a different model from the dropdown
User observes the selected model becomes active
scenarios.expected_result: The newly selected AI model becomes the active model for conversations

scenarios.title: Access Upgrade Options
scenarios.business_objective: Provide users access to subscription upgrade options
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Upgrade button is visible
steps: User clicks the Upgrade button
User observes the Upgrade dialog or subscription page is displayed
scenarios.expected_result: An upgrade dialog or subscription page is displayed to the user

scenarios.title: Toggle Sidebar Visibility
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to manage screen real estate by collapsing or expanding the sidebar
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Sidebar is visible
steps: User clicks the sidebar toggle button
User observes the sidebar collapses
User clicks the sidebar toggle button again
User observes the sidebar expands
scenarios.expected_result: The sidebar can be collapsed and expanded via the toggle control

scenarios.title: Start New Conversation
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to start fresh conversations without previous context
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
User may have an existing conversation open
steps: User clicks the New Chat button
User observes a new conversation is created
User observes the prompt textbox is empty
scenarios.expected_result: A new conversation is created with an empty prompt textbox ready for input

scenarios.title: Access Previous Conversations
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to continue or review their conversation history
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
User has previous conversations available in the sidebar
steps: User clicks on a previous conversation in the sidebar
User observes the selected conversation opens
scenarios.expected_result: The selected previous conversation is opened and displayed

scenarios.title: Access Settings
scenarios.business_objective: Provide users access to application settings and configuration options
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Settings icon is visible
steps: User clicks the Settings icon
User observes the Settings panel is displayed
scenarios.expected_result: The Settings panel is opened showing configuration options

scenarios.title: Access Search Functionality
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to search through conversations or content
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Search icon is visible
steps: User clicks the Search icon
User observes the Search interface is displayed
scenarios.expected_result: The Search interface is opened allowing users to search content

scenarios.title: Navigate Using Keyboard
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure accessibility by providing keyboard navigation through all interface controls
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
User is using keyboard for navigation
steps: User presses the Tab key repeatedly
User observes focus moves sequentially through all interactive controls
scenarios.expected_result: All interactive controls can be accessed sequentially using the Tab key

scenarios.title: Access Voice Input
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to provide voice input as an alternative to typing
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
Microphone button is visible
steps: User clicks the Microphone button
User observes the microphone interface or permission dialog is displayed
scenarios.expected_result: The microphone interface is displayed or permission dialog appears for voice input

scenarios.title: Monitor AI Response Generation
scenarios.business_objective: Provide visual feedback to users during AI processing to indicate system activity
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
User has submitted a prompt
steps: User observes AI response generation begins
User observes a loading indicator is displayed during generation
User waits for the response to complete
scenarios.expected_result: A loading indicator is visible while the AI generates a response

scenarios.title: Maintain Conversation State After Refresh
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure data persistence so users don't lose their conversation progress
preconditions: User is on the Gemini Home page
User has an active conversation with chat history
steps: User refreshes the browser page
User observes the page reloads
User verifies the conversation and chat history are still present
scenarios.expected_result: The conversation and chat history are preserved and displayed after page refresh
